controls_used.control: Color mixer. Left and right arrows chang

notes.b1/j1/F-r1: Simple, faithful two-color mixer with a ratio slider, glyph-shaded preview and hex/rgb readout, but the ASCII picture is a small muted box and the mix is visually flat.
notes.b1/j1/Q-r1: Pigment pots, selectable mixing models and a colorful painted ASCII grid make a rich, visibly working engine, though it is somewhat more than 'simple'.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Bowl-and-canvas concept works but the canvas looks empty and dotted at rest, the glyph grid does not fill its panel, and the first controls change little visibly.
notes.b1/j1/Q-r2: Pigment-parts mixer with ASCII bowl and light/paint modes works and shows blending, but starts empty and dark so the first view conveys little, and the glyph blob is dim.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Paint-on-grid with RGB sliders, mix modes and a two-color mixer is full-featured and interactive, but the sparse dotted glyphs are small and the panel is crowded for 'simple'.
notes.b1/j1/F-r2: Two-color ratio mixer with a command prompt is compact and works, but the glyph field looks like noisy purple punctuation and the prompt input is more obscure than a simple interaction needs.
notes.b1/j2/Q-r2: Pigment-bowl mixer with a glyph blob and paint/light modes is on-brief, but the dark, dim glyphs are barely visible at rest and the mix reads weakly.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Full painting canvas with RGB sliders, three mix modes and a two-colour mixer is rich, though it opens mostly empty and has many controls.
notes.b1/j2/F-r2: Clean two-colour ratio mixer with a glyph ramp, command prompt and mean versus linear modes; it is focused but narrow and less playful.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Bowl-and-brush design is sound, but the blank black canvas has a faint dot grid that only fills part of its width, and clicking a pigment shows no visible result.
notes.b1/j2/Q-r1: Polished dark UI with pigment pots, paint/light/naive models and a pre-painted colourful ASCII grid, so the mixing shows at once; the grid is drawable.
notes.b1/j2/F-r1: Compact, well-made A/B mixer with a shaded glyph preview, a hex readout and full keyboard shortcuts, but it only mixes two colours.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Paint-on-grid mixer with three mix modes and a two-color mixer, but it starts nearly empty, the glyphs are tiny and the panel is crowded.
notes.b1/j3/F-r2: Clean two-color ratio mixer with a command prompt and arrow keys, but the ASCII picture is a static pattern and the interaction is fairly modest.
notes.b1/j3/Q-r2: Pigment bowl with paint and light models and kept mixes, but it opens with an empty bowl and a dim, near-invisible glyph field.
notes.b1/j3/F-r1: Simple, polished A/B mixer with a live shaded ASCII swatch, a gradient ramp, model toggle and shortcuts, and it holds up on mobile.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Bowl and paint canvas with several models, but the canvas looks half-filled with dots, the page is empty at rest and it overflows on mobile.
notes.b1/j3/Q-r1: Pigment pots with paint, light and naive models paint a vivid pre-seeded ASCII grid with smudge and chips, and it is rich, legible and responsive.
notes.b2/j1/F-r3: Clear two-color ratio mixer comparing sRGB mean with linear light, keyboard shortcuts and copy, but the ASCII is a tiny dull block and the page is sparse.
notes.b2/j1/Q-r3: Drop-ink field with light/paint models and per-cell readout is seeded with a striking mix, themed, and works well on mobile.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Paint-the-canvas mixer with ramps and modes is feature-rich, but it opens as a black void with a mismatched white panel area and nothing to see until you drag.
notes.b2/j1/Q-r4: Three draggable color sources with amounts and Light/Paint/Naive models fill the ASCII field with a live blended gradient and a probe readout, with a good mobile layout.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Ink mixer with a live ASCII swatch and paint canvas, but the canvas starts blank black, the layout leaves dead space, and controls are busy.
notes.b2/j1/F-r4: Elegant two-color sphere rendered in ASCII with a ratio strip, models and keyboard control; the controls fall below the fold on desktop but it stays focused and polished.
notes.b2/j2/Q-r4: Alive at rest with three draggable colored sources, Light/Paint/Naive models, readable mix swatch and probe, and a clean mobile stack.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Ink mixer with RGB sliders, modes and ramps works, but the canvas opens as an empty black rectangle and the layout is plain with the canvas not filling its card.
notes.b2/j2/F-r4: Elegant two-color ratio mix as an ascii disc with a gradient strip and a channel-mean versus linear-light model, but narrow in scope and the model controls fall below the fold.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Paint-on-canvas mixer with modes, ramps and pick-from-canvas, but it opens as an empty black box in a half-empty white card and does nothing until the user draws.
notes.b2/j2/Q-r3: Pre-seeded drops of red, green and blue show additive mixing in colored ascii, with a Light/Paint toggle that swaps the inks to CMY, plus a cell inspector and a good phone layout.
notes.b2/j2/F-r3: Compact two-color comparison of sRGB and linear-light mixing with keyboard shortcuts and hex validation, but the result is small and the ascii is mostly a single repeated tile.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Many controls and a live ink preview, but the canvas starts blank black and the small canvas sits beside a lot of empty space.
notes.b2/j3/F-r4: Elegant two-color ratio mixer with a glyph orb and hex validation, but it is a single static mix, a bit passive and cut off below the fold on desktop.
notes.b2/j3/Q-r4: Rich three-source field with draggable sources, light/paint/naive models and a probe, immediately colorful and responsive on mobile.
notes.b2/j3/F-r3: Useful side-by-side comparison of sRGB vs linear light with keyboard shortcuts, but the ASCII output is a tiny static block and the design is plain.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Paint-on-canvas mixer with picker, but it opens empty and black, and the canvas card has a dead white area below the canvas.
notes.b2/j3/Q-r3: Pre-seeded paintable field showing additive vs subtractive mixing with a theme flip, clear ink buttons and cell inspector; polished and works well on mobile.
